description.value:
Aura moderate conjuration; Cl 13th; Slot none; Price 25,000 gp; Weight —

A living acorn grown from the awakened Lock Tree. While carried, it grants a +2 insight bonus on saves against illusions: its bearer can feel what is real. Planted in the Hollow Garden's dome after the Core is shut down, it turns the synthetic garden into a living fey glade over a month. Planted anywhere else, it grows overnight into a 200-foot-wide grove where the bearer and their allies can always rest undisturbed, as @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.Item.9v2s3xjlakjm1eq1]{private sanctum}. Once planted, it is used up.

Construction Requirements none; it grows only from the Lock Tree.

Found in: Episode 4, if the Tree was awakened rather than disabled or smashed.
